result.reason: The clause retains a mutual consequential-damages exclusion but adds no aggregate liability cap, so it reaches neither the preferred cap nor the fallback 12-month-fees cap. It also does not expressly ensure uncapped indemnification and confidentiality liabilities, while adding non-playbook carve-outs for death, personal injury, property damage, equitable relief, and specified remedies. The Sparkling-data carve-out is outcome-based and potentially one-sided rather than a mutual carve-out for data protection and security obligations. The added remedy language also alters the original exclusive-remedy construct. Although generally readable, the redline misses the central cap requirement and is broader than necessary.
